svg.title: StreetSweeper hand-out sticker - https://crf-eoins-projects-99ff5888.vercel.app
svg.desc: 85x54 mm die-cut sticker, 3 mm bleed. The magenta contour is the cut line and is named CutContour; it must print as a spot colour, not composite. QR is error-correction level H, 41x41 modules over 28 mm.
